name: afya-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya health system navigation — NHIF coverage, facility finder, maternal health, CHW support, and essential medicines. 6 tools.

tools.name: nhif_coverage_query
tools.description: Query NHIF coverage for a procedure or condition. Returns benefit limits, member eligibility, and accredited facilities.

tools.name: health_facility_finder
tools.description: Find accredited health facilities near a Kenya county or sub-county. Returns name, level (dispensary to referral), NHIF status.

tools.name: chw_service_lookup
tools.description: Lookup Community Health Worker (CHW) services available in a Kenya sub-county. Returns primary care scope and referral pathways.

tools.name: maternal_health_guide
tools.description: Maternal health milestones, ANC visit schedule, and danger signs for Kenya. Returns trimester-specific guidance.

tools.name: essential_medicines
tools.description: Query Kenya Essential Medicines List for a condition or drug name. Returns availability tier, cost estimate, and generic options.

tools.name: health_rights_query
tools.description: Query patient rights under Kenya Health Act 2017. Returns rights, complaint channels, and consumer protection.
